politique:
Data controller

Soronate, 5 place de Rungis, 75013 Paris, France.

Data processed

The contact form sends no data to a server of this site: it prepares a message in your email app (or in Gmail if you choose it), which you send yourself. The information you enter (name, email address, travel plans) is used only to reply to your request and kept for as long as needed to handle it, then as required by applicable law.

Legal basis

Replying to your request relies on pre-contractual measures and on our legitimate interest in answering enquiries. Any non-essential trackers rely on your consent.

Cookies and local storage

This site uses no advertising cookies and no audience measurement. Your display preference (light or dark mode) is stored locally in your browser. Your cookie choice is managed by Axeptio; you can change it at any time with the “Manage cookies” link in the footer.

Third-party services

Photographs are loaded from Wikimedia Commons servers (Wikimedia Foundation), which receive your IP address and technical information. The same applies to the Riga weather widget, provided by Open-Meteo. The host, GitHub Pages, may keep connection logs. If you choose “Open in Gmail”, you leave this site for a Google service.

Your rights

You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability. To exercise them: . You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr).
accessibilite:
Commitment

SOROBALTE aims to make this website accessible, targeting the RGAA and WCAG 2.1 (level AA) criteria.

Compliance status

The site has not been audited by a third party: its compliance level has not been assessed yet.

Measures in place

  • Skip link, heading structure and declared page language.
  • Keyboard navigation with visible focus, including in the gallery (Esc and arrow keys).
  • Dark mode, and animations switched off if your system asks for it.
  • Touch targets of at least 44 px and labelled form fields.
  • Alternative text on informative images.

Known limitations

The map of Latvia is schematic: the same information is available in the text of each section. Third-party content (Axeptio consent banner, Wikimedia Commons photographs) is not fully under our control. Latvian texts are still being proofread.

Report a problem

If some content is not accessible, write to us: . If you do not get a satisfactory answer, you may contact the French Defender of Rights (online form).
